Concepts

This case-sensitive code system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-EntityStatus defines the following codes in a Is-A hierarchy:

LvlCodeDefinitionStatus
1normal The 'typical' state. Excludes "nullified" which represents the termination state of an Entity record instance that was created in error.active
2  active The state representing the fact that the Entity record is currently active.active
2  inactive **Definition:** The state representing the fact that the entity is inactive.active
2  terminated The state representing the normal termination of an Entity record.retired
1nullified The state representing the termination of an Entity record instance that was created in error.active
